original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹阿韦尔一名17岁摩托车骑手遭枪击并被抢劫
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹北加扎勒河州首府阿韦尔，一名17岁摩托车骑手在搭载两名乘客途中遭枪击受伤，摩托车被抢走。警方称事件发生在周日傍晚6时30分左右，地点靠近世界粮食计划署仓库，伤者正在阿韦尔州立医院接受治疗，警方已展开追捕。一名骑手和当地和平文化协会负责人对袭击表示谴责，后者将其与日益恶化的经济困难联系起来。

location.site: 世界粮食计划署仓库附近
location.raw_text: Aweil, the capital of Northern Bahr el Ghazal State, near World Food Programme (WFP) warehouses

key_facts.fact: 一名17岁摩托车骑手在阿韦尔遭两名乘客枪击受伤并被抢走摩托车
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A 17-year-old boda boda rider was shot and wounded before two passengers robbed him of his motorcycle in Aweil, the capital of Northern Bahr el Ghazal State, police said.

key_facts.fact: 警方称事件发生在周日傍晚约6时30分，地点靠近世界粮食计划署仓库
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident occurred on Sunday at about 6:30 p.m. ... As they approached the WFP warehouses, the two suspects shot him in the left hand with a pistol and made away with the bike.

key_facts.fact: 伤者正在阿韦尔州立医院接受治疗，警方已展开追捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The boy is under medication at Aweil State Hospital, and a manhunt has been launched for the assailants.

key_facts.fact: 当地和平文化协会负责人谴责袭击并将其与恶化的经济困难相联系
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Wek Garang, executive director of the Peace Culture Association (PCA), condemned the attack and linked the incident to worsening economic hardship.

uncertainties: 两名嫌疑人身份尚未确认，警方仍在追捕中
事件目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
